biography: Raj Shukla is a Software Architect · Generative AI Engineer · Technical Author specializing in dependable Agentic AI systems built with .NET, C#, and Azure.
His work spans distributed systems, AI agents, agentic workflows, context engineering, and the architecture needed to make agentic systems observable, durable, and useful beyond the prototype stage.
Raj is the author of the Building AI Agents with .NET series, which translates emerging agent patterns into practical engineering approaches for the Microsoft ecosystem.
